SOURCE_KEY: project:db/init/10_demo.sql
SOURCE_TYPE: deployment
SOURCE_TITLE: db/init/10_demo.sql
SOURCE_URI: project://db/init/10_demo.sql
---
-- Demo data is deliberately ordinary relational data generated by PostgreSQL.
-- No timing or tuning result is stored here; every result shown by the app is
-- measured after the workload runs.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS keeninsight_demo;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS keeninsight_demo.customers (
customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
region TEXT NOT NULL,
created_at DATE NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO keeninsight_demo.customers (customer_id, region, created_at)
SELECT g,
(ARRAY['APAC', 'EMEA', 'AMER', 'LATAM'])[((g - 1) % 4) + 1],
DATE '2020-01-01' + ((g * 17) % 1400)
FROM generate_series(1, 20000) AS g
ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS keeninsight_demo.orders (
order_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
order_date DATE NOT NULL,
amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL,
status TEXT NOT NULL,
note TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- There is intentionally no index on orders.customer_id. The application
-- measures whether a validated candidate index helps this actual workload.
INSERT INTO keeninsight_demo.orders
(order_id, customer_id, order_date, amount, status, note)
SELECT g,
(((g::bigint * 7919) % 20000) + 1)::integer,
DATE '2023-01-01' + ((g * 13) % 730),
((g * 37) % 100000)::numeric / 100,
(ARRAY['NEW', 'PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'CANCELLED'])[((g - 1) % 4) + 1],
md5(g::text || ':keeninsight-demo')
FROM generate_series(1, 800000) AS g
ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS keeninsight_demo.accounts (
account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
balance NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO keeninsight_demo.accounts (account_id, balance)
SELECT g, 1000.00 FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS g
ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO NOTHING;

-- A separate 50k-row probe supports a non-index good case: a distribution
-- shift makes the catalog statistics stale, and the demo can recover with a
-- typed ANALYZE action. It is never read by the other workload scenarios.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS keeninsight_demo.stats_probe (
probe_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
category TEXT NOT NULL,
payload TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- The probe intentionally demonstrates stale planner statistics. Keep this
-- isolated table from being auto-analyzed during the short distribution-shift
-- window; the regular demo tables retain default autovacuum behavior.
ALTER TABLE keeninsight_demo.stats_probe SET (autovacuum_enabled = false);

INSERT INTO keeninsight_demo.stats_probe (probe_id, category, payload)
SELECT g,
CASE WHEN g <= 49000 THEN 'common' ELSE 'rare' END,
md5(g::text || ':keeninsight-stats-probe')
FROM generate_series(1, 50000) AS g
ON CONFLICT (probe_id) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE keeninsight_demo.stats_probe
SET category = CASE WHEN probe_id <= 49000 THEN 'common' ELSE 'rare' END;

ANALYZE keeninsight_demo.customers;
ANALYZE keeninsight_demo.orders;
ANALYZE keeninsight_demo.accounts;
ANALYZE keeninsight_demo.stats_probe;

-- This container is a fresh, isolated demo instance. Do not let setup work
-- appear as the first measured workload in pg_stat_statements.
SELECT pg_stat_statements_reset();
